description: Implementation of ctype functions via regex in the Symfony Polyfill component, providing character type checks such as alnum, alpha, digit, etc.

classes.name: Ctype
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for character type checks using regex, as part of Symfony's polyfill for ctype functions.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are alphanumeric (letters or digits).

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are alphabetic letters.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are control characters.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are decimal digits.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are printable and create visible output.

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are lowercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are printable, including space.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are punctuation characters.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are whitespace characters.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are uppercase letters.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if all characters in the input are hexadecimal digits.
